title: Degree bound for a binary polynomial
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every vector $\gamma\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, form the polynomial over the binary extension field of degree $\ell$ whose coefficient of $X^{i+1}$ is the image of the $i$th coordinate of $\gamma$. Its natural degree is at most $n$.
